title: Cyberbullying: Don’t Participate, Stop It
summary: Cyberbullying is more dangerous: it’s 24/7, reaches the home, and lasts forever. Teach your child: (1) Don’t participate or play the role of the bystander (2) Take a screenshot + report to the platform + tell a parent (3) The National Centre for Electronic Development (19099) for serious reports.
try_this: Practice a scenario: "If you see bullying against a friend, what do you do?" — Train them on: screenshot → report → tell me.
reflection_prompts: Has your child been exposed to or witnessed cyberbullying?
Do they know the reporting number (19099)?
